hero.title: A passion born in the heart of Valais vineyards

valais.title: Valais, cradle of viticultural excellence
valais.paragraph1: Between the Alpine peaks and the winding Rhone, Valais is home to Switzerland's sunniest vineyard. Here, grape varieties found nowhere else in the world - Petite Arvine, Amigne, Cornalin, Humagne - tell a thousand-year-old story.
valais.paragraph2: Every bottle is the fruit of expertise passed down through generations, exceptional geology, and a microclimate that the world's greatest terroirs envy.
valais.highlight: Valais wines have nothing to envy anyone. It's time the world knew.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.content: EnCave was created for all those who, like me, believe that every bottle deserves its story. Manage your cellar, track your tastings, discover the perfect moment to open your treasures - and above all, celebrate the richness of our wine heritage.

contact.title: The craftsman behind the app
contact.content: This project is a personal creation, developed with passion and dedication. If you have questions, suggestions, or simply want to share your love of wine, don't hesitate to reach out.
contact.name: Samuel

about.footer: Cheers, and long live Valais wines!

metadata.title: Wine Tasting in Valais | EnCave
metadata.description: Discover the best wine tastings in Valais. Book a unique oenological experience with Valais winemakers. Petite Arvine, Fendant, Cornalin and more.
metadata.keywords: wine tasting valais, valais cellar, wine tourism valais, swiss wine, petite arvine, fendant, cornalin

hero.title: Wine Tasting in Valais
hero.subtitle: Experience authentic wine culture in the heart of Swiss vineyards

intro.title: The art of Valais wine tasting
intro.paragraph1: Valais, Switzerland's largest wine-growing canton, offers exceptional conditions for viticulture thanks to its record sunshine and varied terroirs. From Visp to Martigny, the steep slopes are home to grape varieties found nowhere else in the world.
intro.paragraph2: A tasting in Valais is much more than a simple wine discovery: it's an immersion into ancestral know-how, passed down from generation to generation by passionate winemakers.
intro.paragraph3: Whether you're an enlightened enthusiast or a curious newcomer, our partner wineries welcome you to share their passion and help you discover the hidden treasures of Valais viticulture.

q1.question: How much does a wine tasting in Valais cost?
q1.answer: Prices generally range from CHF 20 to 80 per person depending on the winery and type of experience. A simple tasting starts around CHF 20-30, while a complete experience with cellar visit and food pairing can reach CHF 60-80.

q2.question: Do I need to book in advance for a tasting?
q2.answer: Yes, we strongly recommend booking in advance, especially during peak season (May-October) and weekends. Booking guarantees your spot and allows winemakers to prepare a personalized experience.

q3.question: What wines can I taste in Valais?
q3.answer: Valais is famous for its native grape varieties: Petite Arvine, Amigne, Cornalin, Humagne Rouge and Blanc. You'll also discover excellent Fendant (Chasselas), Pinot Noir and unique blends.

q4.question: Are tastings suitable for beginners?
q4.answer: Absolutely! Our partner winemakers welcome all levels. They take the time to explain tasting techniques and the characteristics of each wine. It's the ideal opportunity to learn in a friendly setting.

q5.question: Can I buy wine after the tasting?
q5.answer: Yes, most wineries offer direct wine sales. It's the perfect opportunity to take home your favorites and extend the pleasure at home.

cta.title: Ready to discover Valais wines?
cta.subtitle: Book your tasting and enjoy an unforgettable experience with our passionate winemakers.

metadata.title: Valais Grape Varieties - Native Wines of Valais | EnCave
metadata.description: Discover the native grape varieties of Valais: Petite Arvine, Amigne, Cornalin, Humagne. Complete guide to grape varieties unique to Swiss Valais.
metadata.keywords: valais grape varieties, petite arvine, amigne, cornalin, humagne, swiss native wine, valais grape varieties

hero.title: Valais Grape Varieties
hero.subtitle: Discover the unique grape varieties that make Valais wines famous

intro.title: A wine heritage unique in the world
intro.paragraph1: Valais is home to an exceptional collection of native grape varieties, found nowhere else in the world. These ancestral varieties, preserved by generations of winemakers, offer unique aromatic profiles.
intro.paragraph2: From the iconic white grape Petite Arvine to the full-bodied red Cornalin, each variety tells the story of an exceptional terroir and centuries-old know-how.

petiteArvine.name: Petite Arvine
petiteArvine.description: The jewel of Valais grapes, Petite Arvine produces wines of exceptional finesse with a characteristic saline finish.
petiteArvine.tasting: Citrus notes, rhubarb, wisteria, distinctive saline finish

amigne.name: Amigne
amigne.description: Grown almost exclusively in Vétroz, Amigne is a rare grape with multiple facets, from dry to sweet.
amigne.tasting: Honey, quince, dried apricot, floral notes
amigne.pairing: Foie gras, fruit desserts, blue cheeses

heida.name: Heida (Païen)
heida.description: The same grape as Savagnin, grown at altitude, produces powerful and aromatic wines.
